sentences.text: Hello everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. My name is Emily. In this podcast, we speak slowly.
We use easy English. We learn step by step. Today we travel to South America. We go to the country
of Peru. Our city is Arquipa. Arquipa is calm. Arquipa is historic.
Arquipa is beautiful. Please relax. Please listen slowly. Let's begin.
Part two, Peru and South America. Peru is a country in South America. South America is far
from Europe. It is far from Asia. Peru has mountains. Peru has rivers. Peru has history.
Many old cultures lived in Peru. People lived here long ago. They built cities and temples.
Arquipa is one important city in Peru. It is not the capital, but it is very special.
Part three, where is Arquipa? Arquipa is in the south of Peru. It is not near the ocean.
It is far from the sea. The city is near the Andes Mountains. These mountains are very big.
They are very old. Arquipa is a high city. The city is above sea level. The air feels fresh.
Part four, weather and sky. The weather in Arquipa is very nice. Many days are sunny.
The sky is often blue. It does not rain a lot. The air is dry. People like this climate. During
the day, it is warm. At night, it is cooler. Life feels comfortable here.
Not part five, the volcanoes. Arquipa is famous for volcanoes. Volcanoes are mountains with fire
inside. The most famous volcano is Misty. Misty is very tall. Misty is very beautiful.
You can see Misty from the city. It is always there. It watches the city. People respect the
volcano. It is part of their life. Part six, the white city. Arquipa is called the white city.
Many buildings are white. They are made from white stone. This stone comes from volcanoes.
The stone is strong. The stone is bright. When the sun shines, the city looks white.
The streets look clean. The city looks calm and peaceful.
Part seven, history of Arquipa. Arquipa is an old city. It has a long history. Spanish people came
long ago. They built churches and houses. They used white stone. The city grew slowly. Old buildings
still stand today. History is everywhere. Old streets and buildings. The old city is very
beautiful. The streets are narrow. The houses are close. People walk slowly. They look at the walls.
They take photos. You can feel the past. You can feel history. The city tells old stories.
Part nine, Plaza de Armas. The heart of Arquipa is Plaza de Armas. It is the main square. People
meet here. Families sit together. Friends talk and laugh. There are trees. There are benches.
Life feels alive here. Part ten, the cathedral. Next to the square is a big cathedral. It is white
and very large. The cathedral is important. People pray here. People visit every day. Inside,
it is quiet. People speak softly. The place feels peaceful. Part eleven, Santa Catalina Monastery.
Santa Catalina is very famous. It is a big monastery. It looks like a small city. There are
streets inside. There are walls and doors. The walls are red and blue. The light is soft.
The place is calm. People walk slowly. People feel peace. Many visitors love this place.
Part twelve, food, life, and goodbye. Food in Arquipa is rich. People eat warm food. People eat
together. A famous dish is rocoto rileno. It is spicy. People enjoy strong flavors.
Daily life is slow. People work. People rest. Nature is close. Mountains are near.
Colca Canyon is nearby. Arquipa is a city of stone, sun, history, and calm life.
